tracks.name: Trust governance and safeguarding
blockers: Safeguarding primary, backup, urgent route, geography, and coverage are unassigned.
Trusted approval verification and specialist privacy/legal boundaries are not operational.
tracks.exitEvidence: Named and tested safeguarding route, reviewed trust boundaries, and scoped approval control.

tracks.name: Product and release
blockers: RM-001 is proposed and isolated but unapproved, undeployed, and lacks a verified rollback owner/artifact.
The live public footprint still has major discovery findings.
tracks.exitEvidence: Approved isolated release, verified rollback, clean post-release checks, and stable named build.

tracks.name: Audience and positioning
blockers: No adult research owner, approved recruitment route, or accepted customer evidence exists.
Child/family-led versus broader creature/narrative-led launch positioning is unresolved.
tracks.exitEvidence: Accepted de-identified evidence establishes comprehension, trust concerns, audience choice, uncertainty, and disconfirming signals.

tracks.name: Proof and creative
blockers: Hatch/bond, restoration, and Project Beacon gameplay proofs are required and missing.
No approved proof set has completed provenance, rights, accessibility, representation, and claim review.
tracks.exitEvidence: Three authentic, build-linked, rights-cleared, accessible proof assets approved for their exact claims and audiences.

tracks.name: Owned discovery and channels
blockers: Owned discovery changes are local and search submission is unauthorized.
Channel accounts, owners, credentials, moderation, measurement, and publication approval are incomplete.
tracks.exitEvidence: Verified owned discovery, approved canonical pages, named channel owners, moderation, measurement, and exact publication controls.

tracks.name: Distribution and partnerships
blockers: The itch.io direct-play package is tested, but the authentic visual gate remains 0/4 and D-018 must preserve the Poki-first versus itch.io-first rights choice.
No Poki request, portal publication, outreach, account, terms, exclusivity, SDK, rights, advertising, or commercial action is authorized.
tracks.exitEvidence: Four approved real gameplay moments, a reviewed first-minute and mobile experience, D-018 decision, selected route, rights/privacy/economics evidence, and an exact scoped approval.

tracks.name: Engagement and support
blockers: Support and safeguarding owners, urgent route, inbox boundary, consent, suppression, retention, and send policy are incomplete.
All six lifecycle programs remain designed and gated with zero contact records.
tracks.exitEvidence: Named service owners, tested restricted-case escalation, approved knowledge, adult consent/suppression where required, and bounded human-send policy.

tracks.name: Measurement and finance
blockers: Event boundaries, privacy/DPIA, network/logging, retention, ownership, and kill-switch evidence are incomplete; collection is off.
Entity, currency, cash, commitments, actuals, costs, runway, and unit economics have no verified restricted source.
tracks.exitEvidence: Approved minimal measurement plus reconciled restricted financial baseline, unit costs, caps, stop rules, and runway method.

stages.name: Quiet owned access
blockers: Existing access is not a launch authorization, evidence of demand, or permission to promote.
stages.successEvidence: Production access remains observable and constraints are reported without promotion or market claims.

stages.name: Controlled adult research
blockers: Safeguarding, research ownership, audience decision, recruitment, and evidence-handling gates are unresolved.
stages.successEvidence: Accepted adult and guardian evidence with sample boundary, uncertainty, contradictions, and documented product/GTM decisions.

stages.name: Owned discovery release
blockers: RM-001 release ownership, approval, rollback, deployment, and post-deploy evidence are unresolved.
stages.successEvidence: Approved isolated release is deployed by its owner, reconciled to source, passes rollback/smoke checks, and removes all A-001 major findings.

stages.name: Evidence-led creator and press pilot
blockers: Audience evidence, authentic proof, stable release, verified channels, support, and exact outreach approval are absent.
stages.successEvidence: A small adult-directed pilot reconciles exact outreach, qualified play, qualitative response, support load, and all guardrails.

stages.name: Portal and distribution pilot
blockers: Portable build, platform choice, rights/privacy/economics, support, measurement, and scoped submission approval are unresolved.
stages.successEvidence: One bounded platform pilot produces reconciled technical, audience, cost, rights, reliability, and support evidence.

stages.name: Broader public launch
blockers: No repeatable awareness-to-meaningful-play path or complete trust, proof, support, measurement, finance, incident, and rollback readiness exists.
stages.successEvidence: A governed launch stays within trust, activation, reliability, support, capacity, and cost guardrails and produces reviewable evidence.

stages.name: Paid acquisition and monetization
blockers: A proven organic path, lawful measurement, verified financial baseline, unit economics, pricing/legal review, caps, and stop rules do not exist.
stages.successEvidence: A strictly capped adult-directed test demonstrates sustainable economics without child targeting, dark patterns, trust harm, or uncontrolled variable cost.
